name: Dried fish
summary: Khô cá is dried fish, a specialty UBND phường Châu Đốc names beside mắm Châu Đốc. Drying fish is one of the ward’s traditional trades. VnExpress calls the gift khô Châu Đốc and splits it into dried fish and dried beef. A species list for the dried fish was not printed on the ward page.
origin: Phường Châu Đốc, on the ward’s overview. The 26 Apr 2024 VnExpress handbook lists it among gifts to carry home.
howToEat: Buy it at the market to take home, or meet dried fish inside gỏi sầu đâu, where VnExpress names dried cá sặc and dried cá lóc as the salad’s fish.
A drying method and a price were not printed on the ward page. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Châu Đốc, where Vietnam Tourism and the ward put the specialty trade. A stall number was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Khô cá is the dried fish UBND phường Châu Đốc names with mắm. VnExpress lists it as a gift, khô Châu Đốc. A price was not printed.
